theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) blended with subtle Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) accents
theme_and_archetype.rationale: The user requested a timeless, elegant design (Archetype 5) that avoids mass-appealing generic layouts, but explicitly asked for an AI future vibe with Cyan and Violet accents. We ground the bright tech colors in a deep, luxurious 'void black' background to maintain seriousness and authority.

primary.description: Neon Cyan - Used sparingly for key technical highlights, glows, and primary CTAs.

secondary.description: Deep Violet - Used for abstract gradients, background blurs, and secondary interactive states.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white
rules.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white
rules.overline: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-cyan-400 font-['Space_Grotesk']

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Full-bleed hero, asymmetric sections, massive whitespace.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 to create breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Use Mode A 'Tetris Grid' for portfolio bento boxes and asymmetric layouts (e.g. grid-cols-12 with col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and claims. Avoid center-everything disease. Create visual tension via offset positioning.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Sequential text reveal with scale (0.95 to 1) and blur (10px to 0) over 0.8s.
motion_and_interactions.typing_animation: For the subheadline/claim, use a Framer Motion staggered character reveal to simulate typing.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Magnetic hover effect using Framer Motion useMouse tracking. Include a subtle neon cyan drop-shadow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: All sections should fade-in and slide-up (y: 40) using whileInView. Stagger children for lists.
motion_and_interactions.text_scroll: Line-by-line reveal for the Stance/Statement section.

components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50, backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#050505]/60, border-b border-white/10). Desktop links visible, mobile hamburger.
components.cards: Cardless or 'Tracing Beam' border style. bg-white/5 with 1px border-white/10. Add subtle inner glow.
components.buttons_primary: bg-transparent border border-cyan-400 text-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)]

hero_background.instructions: Implement a subtle, slow-moving neural network/constellation background using tsparticles. Particles should be small (1-2px), connected by thin lines, colored pure white or cyan, with 10-20% opacity. Do not overpower the text.

image_urls.description: Abstract swirling purple metallic texture with light reflections. Use with heavy black/gradient overlay (e.g. bg-black/70) for text legibility.
